nodes.name: Underpins
nodes.description: Foundational dependency — the source is a metaphysical prerequisite for the target

nodes.name: Opposes
nodes.description: Binary opposition — the source and target are metaphysical contrasts

nodes.name: Emerges From
nodes.description: Derivative emergence — the source arises from the interaction or synthesis of multiple predecessors

nodes.name: Generates
nodes.description: Creative hierarchy — the source generates or produces the target

nodes.name: Draws From
nodes.description: Energy source — the target draws power or essence from the source

nodes.name: Biome Affinity
nodes.description: Terrain alignment — the source has weighted affinity or influence over the target terrain biome

nodes.name: Contains
nodes.description: Hierarchical containment — the source is a parent or category of the target

nodes.name: Adjacent
nodes.description: Spatial transition — the source and target terrains naturally border or transition into each other

nodes.name: Amplifies
nodes.description: Strengthening synergy — the source enhances or intensifies the effects of the target

nodes.name: Suppresses
nodes.description: Weakening opposition — the source inhibits or dampens the effects of the target

nodes.name: Corrupts
nodes.description: Degradation — the source taints, perverts, or corrupts the nature of the target

nodes.name: Transforms Into
nodes.description: State change — the source transitions or metamorphoses into the target under certain conditions

nodes.name: Seasonal Cycle
nodes.description: Cyclical rhythm — the source and target alternate in influence or manifestation through time

nodes.name: Chaos
nodes.description: The primordial underpinning of all existence—raw potential, formless and boundless. Chaos is not evil or destructive, but rather the infinite wellspring from which all order, structure, and being emerge. It is the silence before creation, the void pregnant with possibility, the ground upon which the binary of Darkness and Light first manifests.

nodes.name: Darkness
nodes.description: The principle of absence, void, and mystery. Darkness is not malevolence but rather the unknown, the hidden, the unexplored. It represents concealment, privacy, rest, and the unconscious depths. Where Darkness reigns, mysteries abound and secrets are kept. It is the complement to Light, neither superior nor inferior.

nodes.name: Light
nodes.description: The principle of presence, clarity, and revelation. Light illuminates what was hidden, makes manifest the true nature of things, and brings awareness to consciousness. It represents understanding, truth, revelation, and the revealed world. Light is the complement to Darkness, neither superior nor inferior, but necessary to create meaning through contrast.

nodes.name: Shadow
nodes.description: The emergent sphere born from the interplay of Darkness and Light—neither pure darkness nor pure light, but the zone of twilight, ambiguity, and transformation. Shadow is the trickster principle: deception and truth entwined, the half-revealed, the liminal space. Shadows shift with the angle of light, representing adaptability, cunning, and the wisdom found in paradox. Shadow is not a third equal sphere like Darkness and Light, but rather the dynamic interaction between them.

nodes.name: Force
nodes.description: The sphere of physics, motion, kinetic energy, and motive power. Force governs gravity, pressure, momentum, magnetism, and the push-pull of physical interaction. It is the sphere of winds, the collision of matter, the tension in a drawn bow, and the irresistible drive of change.

nodes.name: Matter
nodes.description: The sphere of substance, solidity, and material form. Matter is the physical stuff of the world—stone, metal, crystal, soil, bone, and all tangible substances. It represents structure, weight, persistence, and the solid foundations upon which all things rest.

nodes.name: Energy
nodes.description: The sphere of heat, light, electricity, radiation, and dynamic power. Energy is the flow of warmth, the brilliance of flame, the spark of lightning, the radiance of stars. It represents vitality, transformation, intensity, and the active principle that animates and transforms matter.

nodes.name: Life
nodes.description: The sphere of biology, growth, healing, reproduction, and fertility. Life is the organizing principle that animates flesh, drives the flourishing of plants and animals, enables regeneration, and perpetuates itself across generations. It also encompasses disease, decay, and the dark side of biological processes.

nodes.name: Mind
nodes.description: The sphere of thought, perception, memory, consciousness, and intellect. Mind is the seat of awareness, reasoning, imagination, and dream. It governs psychology, perception of reality, illusion, telepathy, and the formation of belief. Mind shapes how the world is perceived as much as it perceives the world.

nodes.name: Spirit
nodes.description: The sphere of soul, afterlife, divine connection, and the essence of being beyond matter. Spirit is the animating force in living things, the spiritual realm where ancestors dwell, the source of holy and unholy power, and the connection between the physical and transcendent.

nodes.name: Time
nodes.description: The sphere of temporal flow, aging, duration, and causality. Time is the arrow of change, the flow from past through present to future. It governs growth and decay, prophecy and prophecy, acceleration and stasis. Time is both the measure of duration and the force that carries all things forward.

nodes.name: Entropy
nodes.description: The sphere of decay, dissolution, randomness, and chaos. Entropy is the tendency of order to break down, of all things to tend toward disorder. It governs decay and rot, the randomness of chance, probability and luck, and the chaotic magic that defies prediction. Entropy is not evil but rather the natural tendency of the universe toward greater freedom and disorder.

nodes.name: Fire Magic
nodes.description: The control and manipulation of flame, heat, and combustion. Fire mages wield infernos, kindle sacred flames, or snuff out fires at will. They often embody passion, rage, or purification.

nodes.name: Ice Magic
nodes.description: The subtractive control of thermal energy, freezing moisture and slowing molecular motion. Ice mages create frozen shields, glaciers, and flash-freeze their foes.

nodes.name: Earth Magic
nodes.description: The command of stone, soil, and mineral matter. Earth mages raise stone walls, shake the ground, or transmute soil into fertile loam.

nodes.name: Air Magic
nodes.description: The manipulation of wind, breath, and atmospheric pressure. Air mages summon gales, breathe underwater, or speak across vast distances through the wind.

nodes.name: Water Magic
nodes.description: The domination of liquid water in all its forms. Water mages part seas, create whirlpools, heal with purifying water, or drown enemies in torrents.

nodes.name: Lightning Magic
nodes.description: The channeling of electrical energy and atmospheric discharge. Lightning mages call down storms, ride bolts through the air, or burn foes with raw electricity.

nodes.name: Plant Magic
nodes.description: The fostering and command of flora. Plant mages accelerate growth, manipulate vines and roots, or infuse plants with magical properties.

nodes.name: Animal Magic
nodes.description: The communion with and control of beasts. Animal mages call creatures to aid them, command animal swarms, or understand animal thoughts.

nodes.name: Healing Magic
nodes.description: The mending of wounds, curing of disease, and restoration of vitality. Healers channel life force to knit flesh, purge toxins, and restore wholeness.

nodes.name: Druidism & Shapeshifting
nodes.description: The transformation of the body and harmony with nature's forms. Druids shapeshift into animals, merge their essence with nature, and walk between civilized and wild worlds.

nodes.name: Poison & Toxin Magic
nodes.description: The crafting and deployment of toxins, venom, and harmful biological agents. Poison mages create deadly concoctions, accelerate rot, or infect with magical disease.

nodes.name: Weather Magic
nodes.description: The manipulation of storms, precipitation, and atmospheric phenomena. Weather mages summon rain or drought, call lightning, or create localized tempests.

nodes.name: Shamanism & Soul Magic
nodes.description: The communion with spirits, ancestors, and the spiritual realm. Shamans journey between worlds, commune with spirit guides, and channel ancestral wisdom.

nodes.name: Necromancy
nodes.description: The binding and command of the dead. Necromancers raise undead servants, commune with departed spirits, and tap the power of death itself.

nodes.name: Holy & Divine Magic
nodes.description: The channeling of divine light, sacred power, and celestial authority. Holy mages smite the wicked, grant blessings, and wield the power of the gods.

nodes.name: Psionics & Mind Control
nodes.description: The direct manipulation of consciousness and thought. Psions read minds, implant suggestions, control bodies, or shatter sanity with psychic force.

nodes.name: Illusion Magic
nodes.description: The crafting of false sensory experiences. Illusionists deceive the eye and mind, create convincing phantasms, and twist perception of reality.

nodes.name: Dream Magic
nodes.description: The navigation and manipulation of dreams and the dreamscape. Dream mages enter sleep, reshape dreams, or pull objects from dream into waking.

nodes.name: Demonology & Infernal Pacts
nodes.description: The summoning, binding, and negotiation with demonic entities. Demonologists gain power through pacts, command infernal servants, and traffic in forbidden knowledge.

nodes.name: Teleportation & Spatial Magic
nodes.description: The manipulation of space itself, enabling instant travel or warping of distance. Teleporters blink across battlefields, create portals, or fold space itself.

nodes.name: Chronomancy & Time Magic
nodes.description: The direct manipulation of temporal flow. Chronomancers slow or accelerate time, glimpse alternate timelines, or create localized time distortions.

nodes.name: Divination & Prophecy
nodes.description: The seeking of hidden knowledge and glimpses of the future. Diviners read signs, scry through crystals, or receive visions of what is to come.

nodes.name: Luck & Probability Magic
nodes.description: The bending of chance and probability. Luck mages tilt fortune in their favor, manipulate odds, or invoke the randomness of chaos itself.

nodes.name: Transmutation & Alchemy
nodes.description: The transformation of one substance into another. Alchemists turn lead to gold, poison to medicine, or rearrange matter at the molecular level.

nodes.name: Enchantment & Artificing
nodes.description: The infusion of objects with magical properties. Enchanters imbue weapons with power, create magical artifacts, or bind spirits into items.

nodes.name: Warding & Abjuration
nodes.description: The creation of protective barriers and the banishment of hostile forces. Warders shield allies, banish monsters, or create sanctified ground.

nodes.name: Summoning & Conjuration
nodes.description: The calling forth of creatures and entities from afar or from other realms. Summoners conjure elementals, call distant allies, or pull beings from the void.

nodes.name: Binding & Restriction Magic
nodes.description: The confinement and restriction of movement, action, or will. Binders paralyze foes, trap spirits, or lock doors with unbreakable seals.

nodes.name: Blood Magic
nodes.description: The use of blood and vital essence as a magical focus. Blood mages use vitality as a reagent, create binding pacts, or empower spells with life force.

nodes.name: Rune Magic & Symbology
nodes.description: The inscription and activation of runes for magical effects. Rune mages inscribe symbols, bind power into writing, or activate pre-prepared enchantments.

nodes.name: Chaos Magic & Wild Sorcery
nodes.description: The channeling of pure, unpredictable power without structure. Chaos mages embrace randomness, cast spells with unpredictable effects, or tap into the void itself.

nodes.name: Corruption & Dark Binding
nodes.description: The tainting and degradation of matter, flesh, or will. Corruptors spread blight, twist creatures, or bind victims to their will through dark pacts.

nodes.name: Restoration & Redemption
nodes.description: The reversal of corruption, healing of ancient wounds, and restoration of wholeness. Restorers mend curses, purge corruption, and restore balance.

nodes.name: Ascension & Transcendence Magic
nodes.description: The elevation of consciousness and the pursuit of higher forms of being. Ascetics use magic to transcend limitation, achieve enlightenment, or touch divinity.

nodes.name: Ocean
nodes.description: The vast open sea—deep, mysterious, and dangerous. Crashing waves, salt spray, and the infinite horizon characterize this biome. Home to maritime trade routes, leviathans, and the unknowable depths.

nodes.name: Coastal Shallows
nodes.description: Where the ocean meets the land—shallow waters, sandbars, and rocky outcrops. Seagulls cry overhead, and the sound of waves breaking on shore is ever-present.

nodes.name: Lake
nodes.description: A body of freshwater surrounded by land. Lakes provide sustenance, beauty, and mystery. Some are serene and clear; others are murky and deep, harboring secrets.

nodes.name: River
nodes.description: Flowing freshwater that carves through the land. Rivers are highways of commerce, sources of life, and often form natural barriers or meeting places.

nodes.name: Grassland & Plains
nodes.description: Rolling or flat expanses of grass and low vegetation. The horizon stretches endlessly, wind whispers through the grasses, and the sky dominates the landscape. Perfect for cavalry and nomadic peoples.

nodes.name: Farmland
nodes.description: Cultivated land bearing crops and domesticated life. Plowed fields, irrigation channels, and scattered farmsteads mark human presence. A place of order imposed upon nature.

nodes.name: Savanna
nodes.description: Grassland with scattered trees, often in warm regions. The dry season browns the grasses; the wet season brings explosive growth. Large herds of grazing animals roam here.

nodes.name: Steppe
nodes.description: Semi-arid grassland with extreme temperature swings. Sparse vegetation, strong winds, and vast horizons define this hardy biome. Home to nomadic herders and tough peoples.

nodes.name: Temperate Forest
nodes.description: A forest of broad-leafed trees that lose their leaves seasonally. Rich undergrowth, dappled light, and the songs of countless birds characterize this temperate biome.

nodes.name: Dense Forest
nodes.description: A thick, primordial forest with towering trees and dense canopy. Sunlight barely penetrates the gloom; the air is thick with moisture and life. Home to ancient creatures and hidden peoples.

nodes.name: Boreal Forest
nodes.description: The northernmost forest, dominated by coniferous trees like spruce and pine. Long, harsh winters and brief summers define this biome. Solitude and resilience are its hallmarks.

nodes.name: Jungle & Tropical Forest
nodes.description: A riotous explosion of life in hot, wet lands. Towering canopy, violent competition, and year-round growth create a green chaos. Danger and wonder lurk behind every frond.

nodes.name: Swamp & Marsh
nodes.description: Waterlogged terrain where water and land blur together. Cattails, lily pads, and murky channels characterize this biome. Insects swarm; the air reeks of decay and life.

nodes.name: Marsh
nodes.description: A cold, waterlogged biome where sphagnum moss dominates. Sparse vegetation, dark water, and a sense of desolation pervade. Strange lights dance over the water at night.

nodes.name: Hills
nodes.description: Gently rolling terrain with moderate elevation changes. Valleys nestle between slopes; forests cling to hillsides. A biome of transition and layered views.

nodes.name: Mountains
nodes.description: Towering peaks that pierce the sky. Snow caps summits, thin air makes breathing difficult, and views stretch for a hundred miles. Home to hermits, dwarves, and ancient dragons.

nodes.name: Plateau
nodes.description: Elevated terrain with relatively flat expanses at high elevation. Dramatic cliffs drop away; the wind is relentless. A place of stark beauty and exposed geology.

nodes.name: Badlands
nodes.description: A landscape of eroded ridges, gullies, and colorful stratified rock. Little vegetation survives here; heat shimmers off the stone. An alien, austere beauty pervades.

nodes.name: Desert
nodes.description: Vast, arid expanses of sand or stone where water is precious. Extreme heat by day, freezing cold by night. Oases are treasured; trade routes cut across the dunes.

nodes.name: Tundra
nodes.description: Frozen wasteland where permafrost underlies sparse, hardy vegetation. Brutal cold defines this biome. Few humans survive here; those who do are tough beyond measure.

nodes.name: Glacier & Ice
nodes.description: Vast sheets of ancient ice covering land and sea. Crevasses hide deadly falls; the ice creaks and groans as it moves. A place of stark beauty and existential cold.

nodes.name: Volcano
nodes.description: Landscapes shaped by volcanic activity. Lava flows, ash fields, and hot springs dot the terrain. The earth rumbles with primal power; danger and opportunity intertwine.

nodes.name: Coast
nodes.description: Shorelines, beaches, and seaside regions where land meets sea. Windswept cliffs, sandy coves, and rocky headlands define the boundary between terrestrial and marine worlds.

nodes.name: Forested Hills
nodes.description: Rolling hills covered in dense forest. Trees cling to steep slopes, creating a dark canopy that filters light into green-gold shafts. Hidden valleys shelter streams and old ruins.

nodes.name: Great Home Trees
nodes.description: Impossibly vast trees whose canopies form a world above the world. Each trunk is wide enough to house a village. Ancient, sentient, and sacred—these are the dwelling-places of elder races.

nodes.name: Broken Lands
nodes.description: Shattered terrain of cracked earth, collapsed sinkholes, and jagged rock formations. Some ancient cataclysm tore this land apart, and it has never healed. Dust devils spin between the scars.

nodes.name: Deep Ocean
nodes.description: The abyssal depths where sunlight never reaches. Crushing pressure, bioluminescent creatures, and ancient things that have never seen the sky. Only the most powerful magic can sustain mortal life here.

nodes.name: Tropical Ocean
nodes.description: Warm azure waters teeming with colorful marine life. Coral formations shimmer beneath the surface, and the air is thick with salt and warmth. Island chains dot these waters.

nodes.name: Reef
nodes.description: Living structures of coral and stone rising from the seabed. Reefs teem with marine life and form natural barriers that protect coastlines. Ancient ones may harbor drowned temples.

nodes.name: Rocky Desert
nodes.description: A harsh landscape of exposed stone, gravel plains, and wind-carved formations. The sun beats down mercilessly on cracked rock. Sparse, hardy plants cling to existence in sheltered crevices.

nodes.name: Sand Dunes
nodes.description: Endless waves of golden sand that shift and reshape with the wind. Dunes march across the landscape like slow giants. Travelers who lose the path may wander forever among the rolling crests.

nodes.name: Arctic
nodes.description: The frozen extremity of the world where ice meets sky. Perpetual winter reigns here, with months of darkness broken by months of pale, unending light. Only the hardiest creatures survive.

nodes.name: Snow Fields
nodes.description: Vast expanses of snow-covered ground stretching to the horizon. The silence is absolute, broken only by wind. Beneath the white blanket, the land remembers warmer seasons.

nodes.name: Tropical Forest
nodes.description: Lush, warm forest with broad-leafed trees and hanging vines. Humidity hangs heavy as birdsong and insect chorus fill the canopy. Life here is abundant and fiercely competitive.

nodes.name: Evergreen Forest
nodes.description: Dense coniferous woodland of pine, spruce, and fir. The air is sharp with resin, and needles carpet the forest floor. These ancient woods keep their green through every season.

nodes.name: Light Forest
nodes.description: Open woodland where trees stand well-spaced, allowing dappled sunlight to reach a meadow floor. Wildflowers bloom between the trunks, and deer move freely through the gentle landscape.

nodes.name: Dead Forest
nodes.description: Skeletal trees stand leafless against a grey sky, their bark peeling and trunks bleached. Something killed this forest—blight, curse, or unnatural fire—and the land has not recovered.

nodes.name: High Mountains
nodes.description: Towering peaks that pierce the clouds, their summits crowned with eternal snow. The air thins, winds howl, and only the most determined travelers ascend these heights.

nodes.name: Mountain Pass
nodes.description: A narrow gap between peaks where travelers can cross the mountain barrier. Passes are strategic chokepoints—easily defended, hotly contested, and often swept by fierce winds.

nodes.name: Floodplain
nodes.description: Flat, fertile land alongside rivers that floods seasonally. Rich alluvial soil supports abundant agriculture. Civilizations rise here, blessed by the river's bounty and threatened by its wrath.

nodes.name: Moor & Bog
nodes.description: Bleak, windswept heathland where the ground is perpetually waterlogged. Peat bogs conceal treacherous depths, and mist clings to the low hills. An eerie, haunting landscape.

nodes.name: Oasis
nodes.description: A miraculous pocket of green in the heart of the wasteland. Palm trees shade a freshwater spring, and the air is sweet after the dust. Oases are lifelines for desert travelers and settlements.

nodes.name: Grove
nodes.description: A sacred stand of ancient trees where life-magic pools

nodes.name: Cavern
nodes.description: A natural underground chamber hiding darkness and forgotten things

nodes.name: Monastery
nodes.description: A secluded retreat where contemplatives seek inner truth

nodes.name: Marketplace
nodes.description: An open trading ground where merchants gather and fortunes change hands

nodes.name: Forge
nodes.description: A smithy where raw metal becomes weapon, tool, or art

nodes.name: Archive
nodes.description: A repository of written knowledge — scrolls, tomes, tablets

nodes.name: Prison
nodes.description: A place of confinement for those who broke the compact

nodes.name: Garden
nodes.description: A cultivated green space where life is coaxed into patterns

nodes.name: Docks
nodes.description: Wooden piers and warehouses at the water's edge

nodes.name: Crypt
nodes.description: An underground burial place where the honored dead rest — or stir

nodes.name: Contested Zone
nodes.description: Territory claimed by multiple factions, none dominant

nodes.name: Holy Ground
nodes.description: Land consecrated to a sphere or faith, defended by custom

nodes.name: Trade Route
nodes.description: A well-traveled corridor connecting settlements, rich in movement and opportunity

nodes.name: Burned
